limitations: Only 8 mice are available; each cohort has two mice and one WSI per treatment arm.
The C0–C1–C2 treatment restriction is post-hoc and exploratory; it must be confirmed in an independently specified and replicated analysis.

Coverage-limited included contexts remain descriptive: C0: 367: 1 tiles, 85 nuclei; 368: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; 369: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; 370: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; C1: 367: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; 368: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; 369: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; 370: 0 tiles, 0 nuclei; C2: 363: 14 tiles, 927 nuclei; 364: 18 tiles, 1136 nuclei; 365: 6 tiles, 401 nuclei; 366: 9 tiles, 606 nuclei
Mouse is the experimental unit; nuclei and tiles are never treatment replicates.
Combined exact randomization uses 36 legal within-cohort label allocations; a naive pooled 4-vs-4 analysis is not performed.
Restricted cluster fractions are compositional and cannot be interpreted independently.
Observed-mixture effects combine context proportions and within-context morphology.
The Kitagawa/Oaxaca decomposition and observed-minus-standardized contrast are descriptive, non-causal algebra.
Classifiers use tiles from the same H&E sections used to define clusters and are not independent pathology validation.
All cluster identities remain provisional pending pathologist review.
